mapper.select: select ifnull(sum(amount), 0) from orders where status = 5 and checkout_time between #{begin} and #{end}
select count(id) from orders where status = 5 and checkout_time between #{begin} and #{end}
select count(id) from orders where order_time between #{begin} and #{end}
select count(id) from user where create_time between #{begin} and #{end}
select count(id) from user where create_time < #{begin}
select date_format(checkout_time, '%Y-%m-%d') date, sum(amount) turnover from orders where status = 5 and checkout_time between #{begin} and #{end} group by date_format(checkout_time, '%Y-%m-%d')
select date_format(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') date, count(id) num from user where create_time between #{begin} and #{end} group by date_format(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d')

select date_format(order_time, '%Y-%m-%d') date, count(id) orderCount, sum(case when status = 5 then 1 else 0 end) validCount from orders where order_time between #{begin} and #{end} group by date_format(order_time, '%Y-%m-%d')

select od.name, sum(od.number) number from order_detail od left join orders o on od.order_id = o.id where o.status = 5 and o.checkout_time between #{begin} and #{end} group by od.name order by number desc limit 0, 10

select ifnull(sum(case when status = 2 then 1 else 0 end), 0) as waitingOrders, ifnull(sum(case when status = 3 then 1 else 0 end), 0) as deliveredOrders, ifnull(sum(case when status = 5 then 1 else 0 end), 0) as completedOrders, ifnull(sum(case when status = 6 then 1 else 0 end), 0) as cancelledOrders, count(id) as allOrders from orders
select ifnull(sum(case when status = 1 then 1 else 0 end), 0) as sold, ifnull(sum(case when status = 0 then 1 else 0 end), 0) as discontinued from dish
select ifnull(sum(case when status = 1 then 1 else 0 end), 0) as sold, ifnull(sum(case when status = 0 then 1 else 0 end), 0) as discontinued from setmeal
